published_implementation.historical_relation: The pinned benchmark invokes Claude Code through its native non-interactive `claude -p` loop with acceptEdits, safe-mode and no-session-persistence on the shared prepared exercise copies. The exact Claude Code binary version or repository revision used during the 24 August 2026 run is not published in the pinned corpus; the canonical review ref above is an identity-linkage snapshot rather than the evaluated runtime revision.

result.model_config: Claude Code `--model haiku`; the source declares this alias as the paired Claude Haiku 4.5 model, while exact endpoint/checkpoint identity is not exposed
result.reasoning_effort: high default according to the benchmark's cited Claude Code behavior
result.repetition_policy: one accepted result per task; infrastructure-only ERROR_API outcomes are discarded and retried by the runner
result.execution_environment: fresh exercise directory per run; common benchmark prompt/task preparation; Claude Code non-interactive acceptEdits safe-mode with no session persistence
result.adaptation_reset_policy: exercise workspace is recreated per task and Claude Code session persistence is disabled; other client-local caches/configuration state is not fully reconstructed from the pinned corpus

observations.notes: The aggregate CSV contains three accepted FALLA outcomes and twelve PASA outcomes. Model-alias equivalence to Kiro's explicit Claude Haiku 4.5 selection is source-declared rather than independently resolved by W1.
